overview:
IMPORTANT: ADDITIONAL PROGRAMM REQUIREMENTS

KENT UNIVERSITY

The University of Kent is a British university with one of its campuses located in Canterbury. The premises are filled with more than 11,000 students each year. The university has its own residence as well as amphitheaters, study rooms, computer rooms and resting areas. The campus has a typical "American" atmosphere.

The University of Kent has much to offer international students and almost 21% of the student body comes from outside the country (139 different countries).

The campus overlooks the city of Canterbury with large green spaces. It’s situated about two hours by train from London.

Kent University is a very popular university. Its former students are regularly in the top 20 of the best salaries for graduates. It was declared the best university in London and the South East by students in 2007.

For advice to travelers issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on England, click here.

Feel free to read the University of Kent presentation (November 2019) here.
administrative:
1) Application Dossier

Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.


2) Visa

For European students, a valid passport/national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).

For non-Europeans students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.

Students in France can use this website: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance

For European students

The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe. To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure. It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks. You can also download it online.

For more information: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger


For non-European students

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay. Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.

Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only: https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html


Campus Life

We remind you that the electrical outlets are different from those in France: so don't forget your adapter! You can find some near the university, but the price is much higher than in France!

The surroundings of the campus are pleasant with lots of vegetation and a nice city center. Maybe it will interest some to know that the Internet connection is good on campus (~ 80 Mb/s).

courses:
Number of Local Credits Recognized by EPITECH

120 UK credits (equivalent to 60 ECTS).


By studying at University of Kent, you can study in one of the three different programmes:

  • Advanced Computer Science (GPA 2.5)
  • Artificial Intelligence (GPA 2.5)
  • Cyber Security (GPA 3.5)

All the programs are taught in English, within the School of Computing.


The number of places is limited for each Masters. The University of Kent will be the sole decision-maker regarding your final admission to one of the three. You can list your choices in order of preference when you make your destination choices.


The classes are mainly composed of EPITECH but with some international and local students.

  • The first semester lasts from September 15 to mid-January (approximately).
  • The second ends around the beginning of June.


For the students deciding to take part in the programs awarding an MSc, you will work on a dissertation/project until September 15. However, Kent University allows you to return to France at the end of August for the return of Tek5.


Types of Diploma

By selecting one of the three programmes, you can obtain the diploma below:

  • Master of Science (MSc)
  • (number of local credits obtained: 180 local credits)


MSc is a diploma awarded in the UK, equivalent to two years of Master in France.

You will study a variety of modules for two semesters and you will study for a third semester, writing your dissertation/project until the beginning of September. Obtaining the thesis enables you to receive the Kent Double Diploma. The thesis (dissertation) is not counted in the Epitech credits.


Obtaining the double diploma requires handling a significant workload.


Please, read carefully the additional fees linked to each diploma offered at University of Kent on the Application Guide.


There is a fees difference between the two diplomas.

3 diplomas (please see the course list here):

  • MSc Advanced Computer Science
  • MSc Artificial Intelligence
  • MSc Cyber Security (certified by GCHQ, the UK government intelligence and security agency) – open since 2017-2018 (choose this course for a discovery in cyber sec) (image analysis module)


Notes

Attention: If you have already taken Java courses at EPITECH, you will not be able to take certain modules in Kent:

https://www.kent.ac.uk/computing/postgraduate

All students who obtain between 750 and 810 at the TOEIC EPITECH (tepitech) must include an English class in their course. Those who get 810 or more will be exempt.


Please note the following criteria:

  • High GPA required!
  • Higher GPA required for MSc Cyber Security
  • Tepitech at 810 recommended (if not, compulsory English module at Kent University)
  • Tepitech at 810 compulsory (to follow the MSc Cyber Security)


Attention: Presence in class compulsory, under penalty of exclusion from the university.

The course list is given to you for information purposes.

It can change from year to year. If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible.


EIP

Any Tech4 abroad involves an EIP!

Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance them.
cost:
Estimated Budget of a Student On Site

  • Round trip train ticket or plane ticket: anything from 50 to 300 euros.
  • Insurance: You will need to pay an Immigration Health Surcharge to cover your access to the National Health Service (NHS), the fees are £470 as of now (early 2022).
  • Accommodations: See the school prices, which change from one year to the next.
  • Sports Center: Access to the sports center is not free. Prices vary depending on the activities. All students will be informed of these prices during the “freshers week,” where ALL associations (sports and others) will be present.
  • Food: €35 to €60 per week. Students will have the choice between Tesco, Sainsbury, and ASDA.
  • The cheapest is Tesco, right in the city center.
  • ASDA is a little behind the city, hence the need for a car.
  • Sainsbury is a large supermarket, easily accessible by bus.
  • The bus:
  • For the whole year: around €180 before October and €270 after October.
  • The bus is very economical in England, and is an excellent traditional means of transport.
  • Count approximately £3.50 for a day-long ticket.


These prices are for personal use only, so they may vary.

To get an idea of the cost of living, you can also find out more here.

Have a look at the application for the tuition fees to be paid.
